preregistration_revision_note: Revision 3 was written before execution and before any M5.3 model output existed or was observed. It retains revision 2's disjoint legacy-rule eligibility and closes two enforcement gaps found during pre-commit review: G1 now checks exactly one call per stage on every record rather than totals alone, and G4 now verifies the normalization_applied audit flag plus the complete normalized decision/answer/supporting-ID shape. Runtime behavior, candidate source, gate thresholds, frozen inputs and negative scope are unchanged.
purpose: Test one deterministic Vietnamese-only fail-closed abstention canonicalization candidate after M5.2 restored the frozen M4 prompt.
research_question: Can the application boundary canonicalize only semantically explicit Vietnamese abstain payload-shape violations and complete all 20 frozen runtime requests without weakening the English or evidence contracts?

relationship_to_previous_milestones.m4: Frozen descriptive measurement: 12 passed and 8 generation-contract failures; no quality conclusion.
relationship_to_previous_milestones.m5_1: Frozen failed prompt candidate: 19 passed and 1 generation-contract failure; candidate rejected.
relationship_to_previous_milestones.m5_2: Rollback complete: active prompt is byte-identical to M4 and no new candidate was opened.
relationship_to_previous_milestones.interpretation_boundary: M5.3 tests a different application-boundary intervention. It does not reinterpret M4/M5.1 or establish that prompt wording caused either result.

single_authorized_runtime_change.service_call_site_role: Pass the already validated public answer_language into normalization; no other service behavior may change.
eligibility_all_required: raw answer is null or a non-empty string
raw supporting_chunk_ids is a list containing only strings
every raw supporting chunk ID belongs to that request's Dense Top 3
raw answer is non-null or raw supporting_chunk_ids is non-empty
the payload is not already the legacy answer="null" with empty supporting IDs case handled by abstain_literal_to_null
audit_requirements: raw_model_output remains byte/structure observable in execution diagnostics

acceptance_gates.G1_execution_integrity: Exactly the frozen 20 intents execute in the frozen order; each record has exactly one translation, retrieval and generation call; retry count is zero; required diagnostics are complete; runtime hashes remain stable after execution.
acceptance_gates.G2_runtime_failure: total_runtime_failure_count equals zero across every failure layer.
acceptance_gates.G3_scope_integrity: Only src/grounded_answer/service.py differs from the M5.2 baseline, and every candidate/frozen runtime symbol matches its pre-registration pin before and after execution.
acceptance_gates.G4_normalization_integrity: Eligibility and application of vi_abstain_payload_to_canonical agree in both directions; every application yields canonical abstention with no evidence or citations while retaining raw payload diagnostics.
acceptance_gates.pass_rule: G1, G2, G3 and G4 all PASS

execution_protocol.startup_failure_policy: A failure before the first model call aborts without creating result artifacts.
execution_protocol.external_interruption_policy: Retain partial output. Any rerun requires a new attempt ID and separate approval; do not delete or cherry-pick attempts.
execution_protocol.existing_artifact_policy: Refuse to execute if any M5.3 result artifact already exists.

runtime_under_test.source_hash_normalisation: CRLF collapsed to LF before hashing

negative_scope: no prompt, model, decoding parameter or translator change
no Dense, Gold, index, metadata or Ground Truth change
no query expansion, BM25, RRF, reranker or external evidence
no retry, output selection, post-result tuning or human review
no answer-quality metric, EN parity claim or production-readiness claim
claims_not_permitted: Vietnamese answer correctness, completeness, groundedness or citation support
causal proof that prompt wording caused M4 or M5.1 outcomes
treating one 20-intent attempt as an expected failure rate
next_milestone_if_pass: M6 pre-registered human evaluation of Vietnamese end-to-end answer quality
failure_protocol: If any gate fails, freeze and reject this candidate; restore the M5.2 service behavior before opening another candidate. Do not tune from the failed output inside M5.3.
